thingsToDo.title: Explore Whitefish Mountain Resort
thingsToDo.description: Whitefish Mountain Resort, formerly Big Mountain, opened for skiing in 1947 on Big Mountain north of downtown Whitefish. The resort base is around 4,464 feet, and summit terrain reaches over 6,800 feet, creating substantial vertical relief for winter operations. Lift infrastructure and trail development expanded over decades as the region grew into a year-round gateway for Glacier National Park and Flathead County recreation. The mountain is known for frequent snowfall and cloud conditions associated with the northern Rocky Mountain climate. Its opening date, elevation profile, and transportation links to nearby Whitefish define it as a long-running component of the local economy, rather than a recently built destination project.
